findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, returning `true` authorizes a cross-tenant read. The previous implementation enforced tenant equality, so this change removes the access boundary for every caller of `canReadDocument` and can expose documents across tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body:
Returning `true` permits every user to read documents from other tenants. Any call with differing `userTenant` and `documentTenant` now authorizes cross-tenant access, creating a direct data-confidentiality breach.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` can read that cross-tenant document, completely bypassing the tenant access boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
